name: BookBundle
description: Symfony bundle providing a publisher's catalog of books and series on the c975L core — media, video, press and marketing collections, EasyAdmin CRUD, paginated public routes, multilingual editions and its own sitemap.

paragraphs: Symfony bundle providing a publisher's catalog of books and series on the c975L core — media, video, press and marketing collections, EasyAdmin CRUD, public listings growing on scroll, multilingual editions and its own sitemap.
Bundle page · Tutorials · Block kinds · Live demo · Demo back-office

Add BookBundle on top of the c975L core to get a publishing catalog — no dependency on SiteBundle, ShopBundle, SocialBundle or any other satellite bundle, so it drops into any c975L site that needs one. Media collections, admin CRUD and export reuse the core's shared mechanisms rather than duplicating them.
features: Book and series catalog with detail views and listings growing as the visitor scrolls
Each book supports media, video, press, and marketing sub-collections with drag-and-drop ordering
Series group books with sorted ordering

What a book is about said apart from what it belongs to: flat categories, as many on a book as it deserves, with a page of their own where the site wants one and read as plain keywords where it doesn't

The catalog read in every language the site declares: a book, a serie, a category, a planche, a character and a person translated on a language screen of their own row, every public page answering at /{locale}/… as well…
